name: Playtime
description: A break with your companion: eleven games you play against it beside it on the desktop (trivia, tic-tac-toe, Copy Me and more) and five puzzles of your own (Daily Word, Sudoku and more), with your scores, best times and streaks kept, and chance to pick a number or choose from a list.
tagline: Games and puzzles with your companion, and random picks
author: Sidefolk
